independence: Each role was filled by separate fresh claude-opus-5-5 sessions (subject x3, safety x2, language x2, lessons split by count), each given only its own role's work orders (openlessons jury orders) and told never to open another role's orders or verdicts; verdicts were written to per-role folders and combined only by jury run after all seven sessions had finished. The drafting model (claude-fable-5) sat on no role.

notes: explanation-correct/misconceptions-sound: the teach text says 'Los seres vivos comen, crecen y respiran' and the reteach test is '¿come? ¿crece? ¿respira?'. Plants do not take in food (NGSS K-LS1-1 clarification: 'animals need to take in food but plants do not'), so a child applying the reteach to a tree or flower is led toward 'not alive', and the lesson plants the known misconception that plants eat. Rewrite around traits every living thing shares at this age, e.g. 'Los seres vivos crecen y necesitan agua. Una piedra no.'

claims.claim: All living things need water; animals take in food but plants do not; living things grow.

sources.title: NGSS K-LS1-1 From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes
